title: CSV to JSON
author: Atlas core
description: Parse an uploaded CSV into a JSON array of row objects, entirely in the process. The source variable, delimiter, header handling, columns and result variable are authored on the task; a following script task then works the array. Columns are derived from the header row unless listed explicitly (ADR-0139).

properties.label: Source variable
properties.description: Name of the process variable holding the raw CSV text (e.g. from the upload task).

properties.label: Columns
properties.description: Comma-separated field names. Leave empty to derive them from the header row; required when there is no header.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Variable the parsed JSON array of rows is written to (rowCount is also set).
